items.desc_en: The government is under intense pressure to tackle a slew of armed groups, many of whom attack civilians.
items.desc_zh: 政府面临着打击大量武装团体的巨大压力，其中许多武装团体袭击平民。

items.title_en: Four Palestinians and two Israelis killed in West Bank shooting
items.title_zh: 四名巴勒斯坦人和两名以色列人在约旦河西岸枪击事件中丧生
items.desc_en: Palestinians say villagers came under attack by settlers, while the Israeli military says a Palestinian stole a weapon and opened fire on hikers.
items.desc_zh: 巴勒斯坦人称村民遭到定居者的袭击，而以色列军方则称一名巴勒斯坦人偷了武器并向徒步旅行者开枪。

items.title_en: Why Jimothy the raccoon has become a mega meme online
items.title_zh: 为什么浣熊吉莫西已成为网上的一大迷因
items.desc_en: It all began with an innocuous video shared by Seattle resident Kiana Hall on Instagram.
items.desc_zh: 这一切都始于西雅图居民 Kiana Hall 在 Instagram 上分享的一段无伤大雅的视频。

items.title_en: Trump considering a ‘massive attack’ on Iran as Tehran labels UK ‘accomplice’ to America
items.title_zh: 特朗普考虑对伊朗进行“大规模袭击”，德黑兰将英国称为美国的“同谋”
items.desc_en: The president told Axios he was considering an operation "bigger than ever before."
items.desc_zh: 总统告诉 Axios，他正在考虑开展“比以往任何时候都规模更大”的行动。

items.title_en: Boom in tech wealth is fueling record prices for dinosaur bones, art and watches, auction houses say
items.title_zh: 拍卖行表示，科技财富的繁荣正在推动恐龙骨骼、艺术品和手表的价格创下新纪录
items.desc_en: The major auction houses racked up nearly $10 billion in sales in the first half, marking one of the strongest-ever starts to the year.
items.desc_zh: 上半年主要拍卖行的销售额接近 100 亿美元，是今年以来最强劲的开局之一。

items.desc_zh: 杰夫·加蒂斯表示，游戏技术成本的上升可能意味着更多的人会在线玩游戏。

items.desc_en: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.

items.desc_zh: 该公司今年早些时候表示，预计将在人工智能投资上花费高达 1900 亿美元。
